decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.
Condition : 4 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in any wall of the extensions hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - A splay of 2.4m x 2.4m shall be provided on each side of the access, the depth measured from the back of the footway and the widths outwards from the edges of the access, and no fence, wall or other obstruction to visibility exceeding 0.6m in height above the surface of the adjoining highway shall be erected within the areas of such splays.

Condition : 7 - The site shall be investigated for landfill gas to the satisfaction of the Local Planning Authority and details of the test results and measures required to render the development safe shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority before the development is commenced.

Where measures are required, they shall be installed before the development is occupied or such other time as may be required by the Local Planning Authority

Condition : 8 - 1.	The proposal, because of its design and appearance, is considered acceptable as it would relate well to its site and would not harm either the appearance of the surrounding area or the living conditions of neighbours. The proposed development therefore complies with Policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development) and H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) and the Residential Extension Guidelines of the adopted London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan.
2.	The proposed vehicular crossover onto North Hyde Lane, measuring 2.4m wide, would be acceptable, having due regard for the site characteristics of No.291 North Hyde Lane and would be safe to use, not impair the safety of other road and footway users, and not detract from the existing appearance of the property or the character of the street scene.  The proposal would therefore be in accordance with policies ENV.1.1  (New Development), T.4.4  (Road Safety) and T.5.3  (Vehicle Crossovers and Hardstandings) of  adopted Unitary development Plan and Section 11 (Roads, Footpaths, Parking and Servicing) of the Council's Supplementary Planning Guidance (February 1997).
description: Erection of a single storey rear extension, single storey front porch extension and formation of a vehicle access to front of house.
